newsitem.title: USA: Mayflower holders don't approve change.
newsitem.headline: Mayflower holders don't approve change.

text.p: Mayflower Co-Operative Bank said Tuesday shareholders failed to pass the bank's proposal to create a Mayflower holding company.

The plan called for the formation of a holding company with Mayflower as the principal subsidiary. It was passed by the Mayflower board in June but failed to obtain the needed two-thirds vote of outstanding shares at the annual shareholders meeting to pass, Mayflower said.

The Massachusetts chartered cooperative bank had said it sought to create a holding company to increase flexibility in its operations, such as mergers and acquisitions, but had said no such plans were pending.
The bank said Tuesday it will continue to look to other means to maximize shareholder value, and Chief Executive Ted Pratt said this would be done through current efforts the bank has underway.
